items.title: Professor Longhair (Henry Roeland Byrd) Interview, 1975-11-13
items.q: In fact, Domino did, you see. So he got the privileges and he got the breaks.

ctx.x: it. I didn't like airplanes and I didn't like ships.

So that hurted me a lot. Since lately I had time to think about it. I mean I put out advertisement money and all of these things and the guy don't want to go along with the procedures you know. So really that's the reason why my records never really got no further than where they did. Because I didn't follow them up. I didn't cooperate in other words. You didn't cooperate with the companies. investment money and all of these things, and the guy don't want to go along with the procedures, you know. Right. So…

items.title: Professor Longhair (Henry Roeland Byrd) Interview, 1969-05-30
items.q: And that's Domino. He's doing alright again.

ctx.x: Yeah, I know a guitar. I hadn't seen him in a long while though, but I'll take that back, I saw him this past year sometime. Yeah, I saw him a couple of months ago. Yeah, he was playing down, I remember a couple of years ago he was playing at the Dutrop, I think, where is it?

Yeah, I saw him about three Sundays ago, over here in Al Jis, at the Great Storm. And that's Domino. He's doing alright again. Well he ain't never doing too bad, he ain't even, I don't know, it's poisonous. Yeah. Or like, he is making more money than an average color crazy, you know, I know that. Yeah. Whether he got it or not, I don't know he's making it. Yeah. And the Alaska Brothers, I know you should know him cause he's, yeah.
